params.name: uplo
params.reference:
On entry, `UPLO` specifies whether the matrix is an upper or lower triangular matrix as follows:

`UPLO = 'U'` or 'u' A is an upper triangular matrix.

`UPLO = 'L'` or 'l' A is a lower triangular matrix.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANS` specifies the operation to be performed as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'} x := A \, x
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'T'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'t'} x := A^T \, x
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'C'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'c'} x := A^T \, x
$$

params.name: diag
params.reference:
On entry, `DIAG` specifies whether or not A is unit triangular as follows:

`DIAG = 'U'` or 'u' A is assumed to be unit triangular.

`DIAG = 'N'` or 'n' A is not assumed to be unit

triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the order of the matrix A. N must be at least zero.

params.name: A
params.reference: Before entry with `UPLO = 'U'` or 'u', the leading n by n upper triangular part of the array A must contain the upper triangular matrix and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. Before entry with `UPLO = 'L'` or 'l', the leading n by n lower triangular part of the array A must contain the lower triangular matrix and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced. Note that when `DIAG = 'U'` or 'u', the diagonal elements of A are not referenced either, but are assumed to be unity.

params.name: lda
params.reference: On entry, `LDA` specifies the first dimension of A as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDA` must be at least max( 1, n ).

params.name: x
params.reference: ( 1 + ( n - 1 )\*abs( `INCX` ) ). Before entry, the incremented array X must contain the n element vector x. On exit, X is overwritten with the transformed vector x.

params.name: incx
params.reference: On entry, `INCX` specifies the increment for the elements of X. `INCX` must not be zero.
